direct_trader_corrections.rule: Automated regression cases used to inspect TP context should contain meaningful higher and lower structure when available so both bullish and bearish destination construction is exercised.
direct_trader_corrections.implementation: Use materially deeper 15m/5m causal history and prefer cases with at least one meaningful reaction destination above and one below the decision price. Do not fabricate a level when one side truly has no meaningful reaction.

direct_trader_corrections.rule: A TP may legitimately be placed at the middle of an active 15m FVG when that FVG is the first meaningful reaction used as the target.
direct_trader_corrections.implementation: Regression must preserve 15m FVG midpoint semantics. FVG may also act as support/resistance when it is the first causal interaction band, but FVG alone never creates a trade.

direct_trader_corrections.rule: Automated regression should exercise substantially more real 5-minute momentum/force opportunities than quiet controls.
direct_trader_corrections.implementation: Prioritize distinct-session authoritative entries first, then genuine candle-story + force candidates rejected only by later room/TP gates, before generic no-entry controls. No new trader labeling is requested.

direct_trader_corrections.rule: WAIT remains a distinct frozen trader state and must never be silently converted to NO_TRADE.
direct_trader_corrections.implementation: Preserve the already-frozen WAIT labels exactly in same-window automated fidelity comparison.

direct_trader_corrections.rule: The trader enters from the 5-minute chart. The 1-minute stream exists only because the bot uses completed 1-minute observations to reconstruct intrabar behavior causally.
direct_trader_corrections.implementation: 5m is the primary entry/decision pattern timeframe. 15m is higher-timeframe context and the separate weak-break three-bar continuation family. The bot may use completed 1m bars internally to rebuild the still-forming 5m candle at exact decision clocks without hindsight.

direct_trader_corrections.rule: Current strategy location/target evidence is limited to structural support/resistance, liquidity/reaction clusters and active 15m FVGs. PDH/PDL/PWH/PWL are not strategy inputs.
direct_trader_corrections.implementation: Automated regression must pass empty legacy daily/weekly maps into reaction construction and must never create or score named daily/weekly levels.

direct_trader_corrections.rule: After the first completed 5m prints beyond support/resistance or an FVG interaction band, the immediately following forming 5m must push beyond that first candle's directional extreme and prove sustained force before normal breakout entry.
direct_trader_corrections.implementation: Long requires trade above the first breakout candle high; short requires trade below its low. Do not delay an already-valid 5m continuation for a 15m close.

sampling.reason: Automated fidelity regression only, not blind or clean edge evidence.
